Emma: Morning all — quick post ahead of tomorrow's mid-year showcase. Agenda below. Please drop questions here and any agenda tweaks by EOD.

Javier: Thanks Emma. Agenda sounds good. Can we add a 10m slot for Dedicated capacity pricing update?

Emma: Added. New order: 1) Exec recap (5m) 2) Product demos (25m) 3) Dedicated pricing update (10m) 4) Ops reliability summary (10m) 5) Q&A (10m)

Priya: Also flagging one demo needs a short infra caveat about model rollout limits — I'll add a slide.

Morgan: Ops will present the incident summary from March and current SLA metrics. Will post the incident digest here for review.

Morgan: Incident digest (short): 2026-03-02 GPU pool OOM -> autoscaler misconfig. Root cause: rollout policy mismatch. Fix: tuned autoscaler thresholds + rollback policy. Latency impact 40m. Action items: adjust alerts, add autoscaler smoketests.

Aisha: I'll collect live Qs during the meeting — can we remind folks to use the q-and-a form so we can triage? https://redwood.example.com/forms/allhands-qa

ops-bot: Recording will be available at: https://redwood.example.com/recordings/1994-midyear-showcase.mp4 (auto-upload after meeting)

Priya: Quick note — can the demos keep slides to 3-4 screens each? helps keep total under time.

Javier: Confirmed. Also prepping a short note on model verification + evals for rollouts.

Emma: Thanks all. Please add any final questions by 18:00 PT. I'll compile for the Q&A slot and tag owners. See you tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Priya: FYI — I've uploaded the slide deck draft here: https://redwood.example.com/slides/midyear-draft.pdf (comments welcome)

Morgan: Uploaded the incident postmortem link: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/2026-03-gpu-oom

Aisha: Reminder: hybrid lunch after the all-hands in Main Hall at 12:30. RSVP: :raised_hands:

Emma: Takeaway bullets I'll read out: 1) product momentum + demo highlights, 2) pricing update for Dedicated, 3) Ops reliability improvements and action items, 4) Q&A prioritized by upvotes. Cheers :sparkles:
